Quality control metrics

control_metrics.Rd

control_metrics() calculates the metrics described in the 'BeadArray Controls Reporter Software Guide' from Illumina. sample_failure() compares these metrics against the thresholds recommended by Illumina.

Usage

control_metrics(raw, FFPE = FALSE)

sample_failure(metrics)

Arguments

raw

Output of read_idats.

FFPE

Set to TRUE if the FFPE DNA restoration kit was used.

metrics

Output of control_metrics().

Value

For control_metrics, a list of 21 control metrics, each one a numeric vector equal in length to the number of samples. Each vector has an attribute "threshold" holding the cut-off recommended by Illumina (samples below the threshold fail).

Restoration

Success of the FFPE DNA restoration. Green signal of the restoration control relative to background. Only evaluated if FFPE = TRUE.

Staining Green

Biotin staining efficiency. Ratio of Biotin (High) to background green signals.

Staining Red

DNP staining efficiency. Ratio of DNP (High) to background red signals.

Extension Green

Extension efficiency of C/G base pairs. Ratio of green intensities.

Extension Red

Extension efficiency of A/T base pairs. Ratio of red intensities.

Hybridization High/Medium

Hybridization performance. Ratio of high-to-medium green signal intensities.

Hybridization Medium/Low

Hybridization performance. Ratio of medium-to-low green signal intensities.

Target Removal 1

Target removal efficiency 1. Ratio of green intensities (+3000 background offset).

Target Removal 2

Target removal efficiency 2. Ratio of green intensities (+3000 background offset).

Bisulfite Conversion I Green

Bisulfite conversion efficiency for Type I green probes. Ratio of green intensities.

Bisulfite Conversion I Green (Bkg)

Bisulfite conversion green background ratio (+3000 background offset).

Bisulfite Conversion I Red

Bisulfite conversion efficiency for Type I red probes. Ratio of red intensities.

Bisulfite Conversion I Red (Bkg)

Bisulfite conversion red background ratio (+3000 background offset).

Bisulfite Conversion II

Bisulfite conversion efficiency for Type II probes. Ratio of red-to-green intensities.

Bisulfite Conversion II (Bkg)

Bisulfite conversion Type II green background ratio (+3000 background offset).

Specificity I Green

Specificity of hybridization for Type I green probes. Ratio of green intensities.

Specificity I Red

Specificity of hybridization for Type I red probes. Ratio of red intensities.

Specificity II

Specificity of hybridization for Type II probes. Ratio of red-to-green intensities.

Specificity II (Bkg)

Specificity of hybridization green background ratio (+3000 background offset).

Non-polymorphic Green

Non-polymorphic query performance in the green channel.

Non-polymorphic Red

Non-polymorphic query performance in the red channel.

For sample_failure, a logical vector, TRUE if the sample at the corresponding index falls below the threshold for any of the control metrics.

Note

You can download the Software Guide at https://support.illumina.com/downloads/beadarray-controls-reporter-software-guide-1000000004009.html
